ablation.aggregation: Within each image and criterion, common determinate eligibility across the listed methods. NA and unknown excluded for all methods together; remaining criteria equally weighted per image. Then mean over all 80 images. D09 historical display-only, excluded from current aggregates/deltas/CI. Binary criteria: Wilson CI. Aggregate/paired changes: image bootstrap10000 seed20261104. CI conditional on one harness rater, not inter-rater replication.
ablation.reviewMethod: Current Codex harness single review; A/B/C prior harness visual review reused only for exact same render hash; vendor visual and all six native D13-D15 re-adjudicated by current harness. Native probes are historical actual Illustrator operation evidence, not historical DeepSeek judgments. No additional paid scoring or independent API receipts.
